user_text: 예산 증액을 승인할게. 이어서 진행해줘. n/T 생성/붕괴를 포함하는 연구 루프도 같이 수행해줘. 한 세션 내에서 가능한 한 병렬로 DAG를 시행해주고 빠르게 최종 목표에 달성할 수 있도록 해줘.
sequence: Prepared tests once; if PASS, prepared projection and plot once; independent outcome/figure review. No automatic retry. Preserve failures and remaining cumulative allowance for evidence-based repair decisions.
parallel_nt_research: Source qualification, theory, implementation preparation and independent review authorized; any bounded numerical allocation must fit the approved shared caps and be recorded before execution. No new heavy or IVP execution.
